source.dataset: NIH NLM NCBI PubMed Central Article Datasets — Open Access Subset
source.source_scope: English MEDLINE-indexed biomedical and life-sciences research article versions; any resulting claim is restricted to this domain

amendment_reason: Q10-SOURCE-001 retained its frozen English Wikipedia inventory and stop result: zero of 24 pages had complete history and attribution evidence, so no page cleared the text gate. This PMC candidate protocol offers per-version machine-readable license and checksum metadata. It is a source amendment, not a finding that the Wikipedia candidates could never pass.

query_protocol.base_query: open access[filter] AND cc by license[filter] AND english[la] AND 2018:2025[dp]
query_protocol.topic_field_note: The frozen [mh] MeSH topic terms restrict retrieval to the MEDLINE-indexed subset of PMC.
query_protocol.ordering: Run each frozen query once with retmax=1000. Sort the returned numeric PMCID IDs ascending; process strata in the listed order; take the first four globally unique PMCID IDs for each stratum before inspecting per-version eligibility metadata. Skip IDs already assigned to an earlier stratum and continue through that stratum's frozen result list. Do not replace a metadata-ineligible candidate. If fewer than 24 unique candidates are available within the six 1000-ID result pools, the metadata gate fails.
query_protocol.version_source: For the frozen 24 PMCID candidates only, inspect PMC Cloud per-version JSON metadata, the S3 object listing, and OAI-PMH compact Dublin Core metadata (metadataPrefix=oai_dc). Do not request full-text or pmc_fm records. Process only identifier, title, creator, date, subject/citation and rights fields; discard any dc:description containing abstract text. Require exactly one available Cloud article version for the PMCID so the PMCID-level rights value can be associated without version ambiguity.
version_eligibility: the raw license_code maps to the CC BY family and agrees with the PMC cc by license search filter
the OAI-PMH oai_dc dc:rights value is exactly https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
the exact XML object is present and its MD5, S3 LastModifiedDate, version and byte size are recorded
article_metadata_exclusions: records with a missing or ambiguous version, rights statement, title, author list, DOI, or source citation

bounds.combined_xml_size_applies_to: all metadata-eligible versions in the frozen 24-PMCID set; if their sum exceeds the cap, do not request any article XML

acquisition_gate.post_request_rights_review: Inspect each selected XML license statement and notices for separately licensed text or media. Exclude non-CC-BY material, figures, captions, and supplements unless their individual rights are verified. Require at least 20 documents to remain before preparation.
acquisition_gate.attribution_record: Retain author names, title, journal, publication year, DOI, PMCID and version, article URL, raw Cloud license_code, OAI dc:rights value, source XML SHA-256, and modifications; cite and acknowledge the PMC Article Datasets as specified in the dataset terms.
